(I personally brought the question up months ago, why isn't it warm, but is the change worth it?) It should be warm. I think everyone agrees on that. Should have been, but is the change complexity worth it? It benefits mev people, so I'm against it :D We could say the same thing about push0 PUSH0 helps everyone I think? I think that's a bad example, `push0` is an addition and not rule change 🙂 I have nothing against the warm coinbase as after-the-change it the spec will be more clear, just that it adds another if/else to the ruleset. Quick summary of the call for those who couldn't make it, given we covered a lot today 😅 ! With regards to the Shanghai implementations, we agreed to include the following EIPs in Shanghai and launch a devnet with them ASAP: EIP-3651: Warm COINBASE EIP-3855: PUSH0 instruction EIP-3860: Limit and meter initcode EIP-4895: Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations We also agreed to keep working on EOF and 4844-specific devnets in parallel, and have them build on top of this "Shanghai Core" devnet, to mirror how the CL teams are having 4844 rebased on top of Capella (which is mostly withdrawals). We also discussed potentially including EIP-4758, which deactivates SELFDESTRUCT, but agreed there needs to be more analysis done here. Next Tuesday 15:00 UTC there will be a community call about outstanding Goerli supply issues: https://github.com/eth-clients/goerli/issues/129 PR moving the EIPs to Included - will merge in the next day or so unless there's an objection: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/pull/633 So where/when EOF working group? Should we organize an EOF breakout call to dive into this more next week? ⏲️ **DST reminder**: I believe DST kicks in the EU next week, and North America the week after, so please double-check the CL/ACD call times in your local time. Quick summary of the call for those who couldn't make it, given we covered a lot today 😅 !

With regards to the Shanghai implementations, we agreed to include the following EIPs in Shanghai and launch a devnet with them ASAP: 

EIP-3651: Warm COINBASE
EIP-3855: PUSH0 instruction
EIP-3860: Limit and meter initcode
EIP-4895: Beacon chain push withdrawals as operations

We also agreed to keep working on EOF and 4844-specific devnets in parallel, and have them build on top of this "Shanghai Core" devnet, to mirror how the CL teams are having 4844 rebased on top of Capella (which is mostly withdrawals). 

We also discussed potentially including EIP-4758, which deactivates SELFDESTRUCT, but agreed there needs to be more analysis done here. 

Next Tuesday 15:00 UTC there will be a community call about outstanding Goerli supply issues: https://github.com/eth-clients/goerli/issues/129
